title: Suhoor vs Iftar: Farq Kya Hai?
script: Roze ke dono siraay kitne mubaarak hain... lekin kis mein barkat zyada hai? Suhoor subah saadiq se pehle roza shuru karne ka barkat wala khana hai. Jabke Iftar guroob-e-aftab ke waqt roza kholne ka khushgawar lamha hai. Suhoor roze ki barkat aur tayyari hai, jabke Iftar ibadat ka in'aam. Aise hi Islamic comparisons ke liye follow karein.
hook_variants: Roze ke dono siraay kitne mubaarak hain... lekin kis mein barkat zyada hai?
Kya aapko Suhoor aur Iftar mein farq pata hai?
Suhoor aur Iftar ko ek samajhne ki ghalti mat karein!
